data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure and order right (arXiv advanced search by topic and year, then Semantic Scholar citation lookup, then a formatted note), but it omits the category parameter and the Subject tick step. It also has the first author coming from Semantic Scholar rather than arXiv, never closes the Semantic Scholar tab, and says "a top paper" where the true workflow opens the first result. Those gaps leave a built automation missing a varying input (category) and with some vague steps.
